title: Skillet Salmon with Mixed Vegetables
description: Salmon fillets seared in one skillet, then asparagus, onion and grape tomatoes cooked in the same pan and spooned over the top with a squeeze of lemon.

ingredients.note: skin removed if you like, cut into 4 pieces
about 1 bunch, trimmed and cut into 2-inch pieces
red and/or yellow grape tomatoes, halved

steps.heading: Sear the Salmon
steps.text: Heat 1 tbsp of the oil in a 12-inch nonstick skillet over medium heat until hot. Sprinkle the salmon with ¼ tsp of the salt and the pepper. Cook skin side up for 6 minutes, then turn, cover and cook 4 to 6 minutes more, until almost opaque throughout and 145°F inside. Move to a plate and cover to keep warm.

steps.heading: Cook the Vegetables
steps.text: Heat the remaining 1 tbsp oil in the same skillet over medium heat. Add the asparagus and onion and cook, covered, 4 to 7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the asparagus is tender-crisp. Add the tomatoes and the remaining ¼ tsp salt, cover, and cook 2 minutes, until the tomatoes release their juice.

steps.heading: Serve
steps.text: Place a piece of salmon on each of 4 plates and top with the vegetables. Squeeze the lemon over the salmon.
